worker_type.description: Type of Rspamd worker: 'worker' (filtering), 'proxy' (load balancer), or 'controller' (web UI).

worker_bind_socket.description: Network address and port the worker binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1:11333' or 'unix:/var/run/rspamd.sock').

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn. Set to CPU core count for optimal throughput.

fuzzy_storage_path.description: Directory where fuzzy hash data (learned fingerprints) is stored. Ensure it exists and is writable.

learning_path.description: Directory for storing Bayesian classifier training data and metadata.

stat_driver.description: Storage backend for statistics: 'redis' (recommended for clusters) or 'file' (single node).

tokenizer_name.description: Tokenizer algorithm: 'ngram' (default) or 'word' (word-based). Affects Bayes accuracy.

bayes_min_tokens.description: Minimum tokens required before the classifier starts making predictions. Lower = faster convergence, higher = more stability.

bayes_min_learns.description: Minimum number of learned messages (spam + ham) before classifier activates.

redis_servers.description: List of Redis servers for distributed storage (used when stat_driver=redis).

password.description: Redis password (leave empty if no auth).

clustering_servers.description: List of Rspamd nodes for clustering (multi-node deployments).

symbols_config.description: Custom symbols (rules) with scores and metadata. Add new filters here.

score.description: Weight added to spam score if symbol matches.

whitelist.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges to whitelist (e.g., internal networks).

blacklist.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges to blacklist.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size (in bytes) to scan. 0 = no limit (recommended for most cases).

max_recipients.description: Maximum recipients per message. Helps prevent resource exhaustion.

scan_timeout.description: Maximum scan time (in seconds) per message before aborting.

dns_servers.description: DNS resolvers used for RBL, SPF, DKIM, and MX checks. If empty, system defaults are used.

controller_auth.description: Authentication settings for the controller (web UI) and API.

password.description: Plain-text password (not recommended). Use hash instead.

hash.description: Pre-hashed password (e.g., bcrypt hash). More secure.

tokens.description: API tokens (base64 or random strings) for token-based auth.

log_file.description: Log file path (used only if log_type='file').

log_debug_modules.description: List of modules to log debug info for (e.g., ['dkim', 'spf']).

modules_disabled.description: List of modules to explicitly disable (e.g., ['milter', 'redis']. Use only if needed.

confdir_local.description: Override config directory for site-specific customizations (auto-included by default).

confdir_override.description: Higher-priority override directory (e.g., for vendor tweaks).
